articles.title: Thailand stocks rise as PTT earnings support sentiment - Investing.com
articles.snippet: Thailand stocks rose on Tuesday as PTT earnings improved and investors assessed the outlook for the Thai economy. The Bank of Thailand said that domestic demand remained stable while companies reported stronger revenue.
